scope: Prescribed subgroup of unbased simple self-homotopy classes on a compact polyhedron; homotopy-compatible realization by homeomorphisms on a compact replacement.
strongest_result: Published C2 counterexample reconstructed on a compact 2-dimensional polyhedron; any realizing action would yield an impossible group extension with 2n=-1.
remaining_gap: None for the unrestricted target under the standard homotopy Nielsen interpretation; restricted variants are not claimed resolved.
